The University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index final reading fell to 51.7 in August, a 6.3% decrease from July.

Joanne Hsu, the director of surveys, made the following comments: [...] Consumer sentiment falls in August after two previous months of improvement. Consumer sentiment sits 11.2% below where it was a year ago and is currently below the 1st percentile in the series' history.
